description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HighlightedMenuItemHostView' that manages a SwiftUI view for menu items, handling highlighting on hover, layout, and rendering. It also provides a SwiftUI wrapper 'MenuHostedHighlightedItem' for embedding this view.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView that hosts a SwiftUI view, managing hover highlight states, layout, and drawing.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the view with a SwiftUI root view and width, sets up the hosting view and layout.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the hosted view and width, refreshes highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment of the hosted SwiftUI view with the current hover state.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the size and frame based on the current width and fitting size.
